files.content:
# Pixel Thermostat

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. The app runs offline and uses only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Use the plus and minus buttons to change the target in 0.5° steps from 10° to 30°.
- Select Heat, Cool, or Off.
- Room temperature is fixed at 21°. Heat reports heating when the target is above room temperature; Cool reports cooling when the target is below room temperature. Otherwise, and whenever Off is selected, status is idle.
